project_name.justification: The project is explicitly named in the text: 'Assay results from the recently completed exploration program on these properties (Figure 1) confirmed the occurrence of LCT bearing pegmatites, specifically on the Cathode, kWatt and Flare properties...'

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified at the beginning of the press release: 'TORONTO, Feb. 15, 2023 /CNW/ - On February 6th, 2023, Orford Mining Corporation ("Orford") (TSXV: ORM) announced it had completed an extensive review...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company, Orford Mining, is named in the text: 'David Christie, President and CEO of Orford, commented...'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that the properties, which include kWatt, are wholly owned: 'The Nunavik Lithium Properties are 100% owned by Orford and have never been explored before for any economic minerals, including lithium.'

primary_commodity.justification: The press release headlines and content clearly state the commodity of interest: 'ORFORD EXPANDS NUNAVIK LITHIUM PROPERTIES AROUND LITHIUM BEARING PEGMATITE DISCOVERIES' and '...confirmed the occurrence of LCT bearing pegmatites, specifically on the Cathode, kWatt and Flare properties...'

The text states: 'Orford Mining Corporation (“Orford”) (TSXV: ORM) is pleased to announce that it has increased its Nunavik Lithium land package by 39 km2 or 8%, expanding properties that are confirmed to host Lithium-Cesium-Tantalum (“LCT”) pegmatites... These three properties [Cathode, kWatt and Flare] were expanded as a result of these discoveries...'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit is specified in the text describing the land package expansion: '...increased its Nunavik Lithium land package by 39 km2...'

resource_size.justification: The text states the properties 'have never been explored before for any economic minerals, including lithium,' which implies no mineral resource has been defined. No quantified resource estimate is provided in the documents.
